description: Get Get publicIpAddress operation retrieves information about the specified pubicIpAddress

operations.description: The Get publicIpAddress operation retrieves information about the specified pubicIpAddress

params.description: The name of the resource group.
params.name: resourceGroupName

params.description: Gets subscription credentials which uniquely identify Microsoft Azure subscription. The subscription ID forms part of the URI for every service call.
params.name: subscriptionId

props.description: Gets a unique read-only string that changes whenever the resource is updated
props.name: etag

props.description: Gets or sets FQDN of the DNS record associated with the public IP address
props.name: dnsSettings

props.description: Gets or sets the Domain name label.The concatenation of the domain name label and the regionalized DNS zone make up the fully qualified domain name associated with the public IP address. If a domain name label is specified, an A DNS record is created for the public IP in the Microsoft Azure DNS system.
props.name: domainNameLabel

props.description: Gets the FQDN, Fully qualified domain name of the A DNS record associated with the public IP. This is the concatenation of the domainNameLabel and the regionalized DNS zone.
props.name: fqdn

props.description: Gets or Sets the Reverse FQDN. A user-visible, fully qualified domain name that resolves to this public IP address. If the reverseFqdn is specified, then a PTR DNS record is created pointing from the IP address in the in-addr.arpa domain to the reverse FQDN.
props.name: reverseFqdn

props.description: Gets or sets the idle timeout of the public IP address
props.name: idleTimeoutInMinutes

props.description: Gets the assigned public IP address
props.name: ipAddress

props.description: Gets a reference to the network interface IP configurations using this public IP address
props.name: ipConfiguration

props.description: Gets or sets Provisioning state of the PublicIP resource Updating/Deleting/Failed
props.name: provisioningState

props.description: Gets or sets PublicIP allocation method (Static/Dynamic)
props.name: publicIPAllocationMethod

props.description: Gets or sets resource guid property of the PublicIP resource
props.name: resourceGuid
